text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat?! Tannhauser got hives and has to
rest, doctor's orders?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... She drank something iffy last night,
and after that intense
training, maybe it
was all a bit too much for her.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I hope she's okay... Oh, shall we all go and
check on her together?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Well, we could... but I think we should
continue our training!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
With the limited time we've got, I think
the best thing to do right now
is focus all
our attention on practicing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Between us, we can make up for
Matikanetannhauser's absence. By

reducing each of our individual times, we
can create a big lead!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
If we create a lead... I see! You're right,
that sounds like a better way
to help her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I agree! But judging by the joint training
we did, we still have a long
way to go if we
want to win. It's gonna be tough.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
No matter how hard it is, where there's a
will, there's a way. Ryan,
may I ask for a
revision of our training program?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Okay! Let's sit over there and talk it over.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
(As things stand, it's clear that I am still
very far behind everyone. I
must do
everything possible to catch up to them!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
(I've got to win and make Big Sister Ryan
proud!)

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Don't worry about the triathlon. Take all
the time you need to rest
up."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Tannhauser! We've come to visit you!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oh?! Is that you, Kita? Come on in.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to bother you as you're resting. Oh?
I heard you broke out in
hives, but...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's nothing too serious. Just a little
rash on my back and belly.
Once the
symptoms wear off, I can come back to
practice.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
That's a relief! So, you can still compete in
the triathlon!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I'm lagging behind now that I've had
some time off though. I'll
have to practice
even harder once I get better.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Please don't overdo it! Your teammates
are practicing enough to
make up for your
absence.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: They are?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
The three of them said they'll do
everything they can! I'm sure they're

training on your behalf too!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
So take all the time you need to make a
full recovery.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! On that note, we'll get going. I'll
leave some snacks for you
next to the
desk, okay?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Right... Everyone's pulling together. In that
case, I'll do what I can
too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I don't think so. I'm inviting you because
I've seen how good you are
at gathering
information and applying your research to
training.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: That's it!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant. My acceleration's still too slow... One more lap!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Are you doing some extra training
too?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Are you about to start too? I
thought you were practicing with
your
team just now.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Well, training with them was so
exciting, I wanted to run some
more!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Exciting, you say?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Just now, when we all ran, it was sooooo
close at the end! It was so
fun fighting
everyone to get in front!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I got so into it, I felt like I had it in me to
keep going forever! That's
kinda weird,
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
No, I think it's great! You have a special
way of seeing things. You're
amazing!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...As for me, I'm not sure I've been running
at the same level as
everyone else on my
team. It made me realize I can't afford to
skip
out on extra practice.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to fall behind... That's what's
keeping me here.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Aren't we kinda the same? You and
me are both practicing
because we want to
get better.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
In your case, it's because you have
teammates that you want to
surpass. I
think that's wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
And I'm the same. I have people I want to
surpass too. No matter what
the race, I
want to win against everybody!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Someone I want to win against...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I get it now! You're right! It's not such
a bad thing to compare
myself to others!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yeah! You can all help each other grow!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Yeah... You know what? You're right!
